title: Nitrogen: simple Recall Potion
description: Bring Recall Potion from Terraria to Minecraft
body: Add three potion to Minecraft: Recall Potion, Potion of Return and Death Reacll Potion. You can craft it from water bottle, ender pearl and dandelion for Recall, Echo Shard for Death Recall and Crying Obsidian for Return. When used, Recall potion teleport you home, Death Recall tepeport you to your last death location, Return teleport you home and create a portal, when you click or hit it teleport you to the place before. Lightweight datapack (may be more optimise in the future).
